title: 3D BIM
description: Create federated 3D BIM models from CAD drawings and BIM models from multiple trades.

title: 4D BIM
description: Integrate project schedules from planning software such as P6 and Microsoft Project with the BIM model for enhanced construction planning.

title: 5D BIM
description: Perform model-based quantity takeoffs directly from the BIM model to accurately track project costs and progress payments.

title: Clash Detection
description: Virtually check for interferences between different subsystems to avoid delays and rework on site.

title: As-Built Verification
description: Cross-reference as-built conditions with the BIM model to ensure that the project is built as per the design intent

title: Scan to BIM
description: Recreate a digital twin of existing assets using LIDAR or drone photogrammetry and convert them into BIM models.
